turns.text: Hey Lloyd, did you see that talk by Chris Noring about AI in dev workflows?
I recall seeing the title. Did you find it useful?
Yeah, actually. The most striking point for me was how Chris Noring asserts that AI-assisted development shifts deliverables from documentation to working demos. It really changes what we prioritize.
That is a significant shift. It definitely reduces the overhead of writing specs upfront.
Exactly. Anyway, my coffee maker is broken again. Just a drip this time, not a full leak.
I'm sorry to hear that. Have you checked the gasket?
I will after this meeting. Do you know if they sell replacement parts locally?
Most hardware stores should have them, but I can check online retailers for you.
